text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate on /v1/generate - P99 latency spiked, 502s from gateway. Pager triggered.

Maya Chen: I'm on shift until 10:30 UTC, taking primary. Ben, can you take secondary for the next hour?

Ben Ortiz: I can, switching now. I'll be local for 30m then remote. If I go AFK I'll handover to Priya.

Priya Singh: noted, I'll be backup. Any customer-facing comms yet?

incident-bot: Incident page created: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-1945
Affected customers: 3 tenants showing 502s, one high-priority (acme-corp).

Maya Chen: ok assigned: driver=Maya Chen, comms=Ben Ortiz. Priya as floater.

Ben Ortiz: happy to own comms. I'll put a short status in #support and DM AMs.

Samir Patel: FYI I'm on-call infra, reachable if you need node reboots or capacity checks.

Maya Chen: initial triage: seems tied to model cache eviction - SLOT_POOL errors in logs. Runbook step 2 says warm caches, fail to pinned model.

Maya Chen: runbook snippet:
```
# runbook: pinned-model-eject
1) check /srv/runtime/kv-cache-stats
2) if eviction_rate > 0.1 restart slot-daemon on host(s) in pool
3) if restart fails, scale up dedicated pool by +1
```

Ben Ortiz: I'm drafting comms now. Short update: "We are investigating increased 502s for text-generation. On-call engineers are triaging; we will update within 15 minutes." Agree?

Priya Singh: yep. Add that we're prioritizing high-priority tenants and have escalated to infra.

Maya Chen: action plan: I'm going to attempt slot-daemon restart on pool-3 (non-prod first) then on pool-1 (prod) if green. Ben please send the first status update.

Ben Ortiz: posting in #support and will DM AM lead for acme-corp. Posting now.

Ben Ortiz: (posted) "Investigating increased errors for generation endpoints. On-call is triaging; next update in 15m. - Ben O"

oncall-lead: quick reminder: document handoff in the incident ticket before your shift ends. If you need to change driver, call it out explicitly.

Maya Chen: noted, I'll update ticket with steps taken and next steps. If restart doesn't clear evictions within 10m, I'll request infra scale.

Samir Patel: slot-daemon restart started on pool-3 (10:12 UTC). Watching metrics.

incident-bot: Detected partial recovery in pool-3. Error rate down 60% within 90s. Prod pool-1 still elevated.

Maya Chen: good. I'll proceed to restart slot-daemon on pool-1 in 2 min. Ben, do you want me to handover driver before that or after?

Ben Ortiz: stay as driver for now; I'll keep comms until you confirm prod restart state. If you need to handoff mid-action say "handoff driver -> Priya".

Priya Singh: standing by.

Maya Chen: restarted pool-1 slot-daemon (10:18 UTC). Observing metrics.

incident-bot: Pool-1 error rate returning to normal over 3m. 502s reduced to baseline.

Ben Ortiz: updating #support: "Issue mitigated: restarts performed, monitoring for 30m. No customer data impact observed. - Ben O"

Maya Chen: recording handoff note: driver=Maya Chen (until 10:30 UTC), comms=Ben Ortiz. If anything flares, Priya will take driver. Leaving detailed steps in ticket.

oncall-lead: thanks. Good runbook use. Assign follow-up: run a cache-tuning experiment and open a postmortem with timeline.

Maya Chen: will do. I'm ending my shift at 10:30 UTC and handing primary to Ben if all stable.

Ben Ortiz: I'll take primary at 10:30. Priya, you'll be secondary?

Priya Singh: yes I'll be secondary 10:30-14:30 UTC.

Maya Chen: handoff complete. Ticket updated with commands run, logs, and next steps. Leaving Slack thread.

Ben Ortiz: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and will escalate if regression.

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated. Auto-update: will revert to monitoring state in 30m.

Maya Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
